fields.name: Form_Greetings
fields.fieldText:
Thank you for completing the online reference check questions for {!Get_Reference_Requests.Selectee_Name__c}, who is being considered for a Patent Examiner position with the United States Patent and Trademark Office. 


Please complete the short questionnaire below to the best of your ability. We appreciate your time and input. 



﻿

fields.name: About_you
fields.fieldText: About you:

fields.name: Title_Organization_Response
fields.fieldText: 1. Please provide your title/organization:

fields.name: Reference_Type_Response
fields.fieldText: 2. Please select the type of reference you can provide:

fields.name: Time_Period_With_Candidate
fields.fieldText: 3. Please provide the time period during which you worked with or taught/mentored the candidate, including the approximate start and end dates.

fields.name: For_an_Employment_Professional_Reference
fields.fieldText: For an Employment/Professional Reference:

fields.name: Analyze_Complex_Info_Rating

fields.name: Analyze_Complex_Info_Details
fields.fieldText: If fail – please provide additional information:

fields.name: Apply_KSA_Rating
fields.fieldText: 2. How would you rate candidate’s ability to apply their knowledge, skills, and abilities to regularly complete work tasks or projects successfully?

fields.name: Apply_KSA_Details
fields.fieldText: If fail – please provide additional information:

fields.name: Timely_Completion_Rating
fields.fieldText: 3. How would you rate this candidate’s ability to routinely complete work assignments and/or projects in a timely manner and under short turnaround times?

fields.name: Timely_Completion_Details
fields.fieldText: If fail – please provide additional information:

fields.name: Reliable_and_Professional
fields.fieldText: 4. Do you believe the candidate was a reliable and professional employee?

fields.name: Reliable_and_Professionall_Details
fields.fieldText: If no, why?

fields.name: Would_Hire_Again
fields.fieldText: 5. Would you hire the candidate or work with them again if you had the opportunity?

fields.name: Would_Hire_Again_Details
fields.fieldText: If no, why?
